children: Group 1 Automotive entered into a Purchase Agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities, as representative of the initial purchasers, for a $1.25 billion senior notes offering to finance its Hennessy Acquisition. The deal comprises $625 million of 6.250% Senior Notes due 2032 and $625 million of 6.625% Senior Notes due 2035, sold at par and guaranteed on an unsecured senior basis by subsidiaries. Closing is expected on Sep 22, 2026, with net proceeds of about $1.236 billion. If the Hennessy deal does not close by the specified outside date, the 2032 Notes are subject to a special mandatory redemption at 100% of issue price plus accrued interest.
: Purchase Agreement for $1.25 billion senior notes offering
: Finance Hennessy Acquisition and related costs; optimize liquidity
